remarks: Elevated interiors. Single-story living. A private pool retreat. Welcome to 15514 La Moine Street, where extensive updates bring fresh style to approximately 2,171 square feet of living space on an approximately 11,273-square-foot lot in Hacienda Heights. From the new front door to the raised ceilings throughout, the details make an impression. New windows and updated lighting complement new luxury vinyl plank flooring, creating a cohesive backdrop for everyday living and entertaining. All bathrooms have been refreshed with tile flooring, custom sinks and marble accents. Beyond the finishes, improvements include new insulation and a roof approximately three years old.
